summary.gist: The custom-silicon revolt against Nvidia is real but confined to inference so far, with Anthropic still running mostly on Nvidia via Trainium and TPU.
summary.watch: Whether custom silicon ever displaces Nvidia in frontier-model training, not just inference, is the open question.
